documents.doc-cz-mk-2026-08-31-mk-53547-2026-socns: The Czech Ministry of Culture discontinued the proceeding on the preparatory committee’s request for a new proceeding and a new decision concerning registration of the Cannabis Church under Section 101(b) of the Administrative Procedure Code. It accepted that the original registration request had been finally refused, but concluded that the new legal, factual, evidentiary and doctrinal circumstances did not justify a favourable new decision. The Ministry treated changes in cannabis law, THC/THCA forensic issues, EU-law arguments and the legal regime of cannabis religious objects as irrelevant to registration, regarded the more detailed explanation of the Church’s teaching as not constituting a new fact, and again concluded that the Cannabis Church did not satisfy the statutory definition of a church and religious society. A remonstrance may be filed within 15 days of service; it has no suspensive effect.
documents.doc-cz-mk-2026-08-31-mk-53559-2026-socns: The Czech Ministry of Culture answered questions raised in submissions of 26 June and 7 July 2026 and later supplements concerning the procedural status and registration of the Cannabis Church. It confirmed that the original registration proceeding had been finally concluded by the 2019 refusal, that the preparatory committee and its representative were and remain recorded as parties, and referred to the parallel order MK 53547/2026 SOCNS. The Ministry stated that it lacked competence to assess THC/THCA forensic methodology, the European Commission position or Danish materials, and treated the EU-law and preliminary-reference issues as irrelevant to the registration proceeding. It also stated that it had assessed the submissions according to their substance, good-administration principles, religious neutrality and protection of religious pluralism, and offered a possible personal meeting on further merits-related questions.
